description_expanded: OverviewSteps to the Private Beach, BRAND NEW renovations, 3 Bikes - 30A Sun JoyThe Space 30A Sun Joy – Renovated Seagrove Retreat Steps from the Beach! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Steps to Private Beach Access – Just steps from sugar-white sand 2 King Bedrooms + Bunk Room – Perfect for families, couples, or friends Fully Renovated – Brand-new coastal furnishings & updated interiors Open-Concept Living – Light-filled layout with Smart TV & plush seating Fully Equipped Kitchen – Stainless appliances & everything you need Private Patio – Perfect for morning coffee or sunset cocktails Bonus Sleeping Area – Includes daybed with trundle for extra guests High-Speed Wi-Fi – Stay connected during your stay 3 Adult Bikes Included – Explore 30A’s scenic beauty Washer & Dryer – In-unit laundry for your convenience Minutes from Seaside, Grayton & WaterColor – Prime 30A location Community Grill Community Pool Welcome to 30A Sun Joy Welcome to 30A Sun Joy, a beautifully renovated townhome tucked in the heart of Seagrove Beach—just a short stroll from private beach access! With space to sleep 8, this 3-bedroom, 2-bath retreat is ideal for family getaways, romantic escapes, or beach trips with friends. Inside, you’ll be greeted by light-filled spaces, all-new coastal furnishings, and an open layout that invites you to relax and unwind. The kitchen comes fully stocked with stainless steel appliances, cookware, and everything you need for easy meals at home. The comfy living area is perfect for movie nights, lounging after beach days, or planning your next 30A adventure. With two king bedrooms, a twin-over-twin bunk room, and a bonus daybed with trundle, everyone has room to recharge in comfort. Two beautifully updated bathrooms make getting ready a breeze. Grab your morning coffee and head out to the private patio or pack up your beach gear and enjoy a peaceful day on the sand. Centrally located in Seagrove Beach, you’re just minutes from the charm of Seaside, Grayton Beach, and WaterColor. Whether you’re biking scenic trails, exploring local boutiques, or indulging in fresh seafood, 30A Sun Joy puts you in the perfect spot to enjoy all the magic of 30A. Book your stay today and let the sun, sand, and joy begin! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 8): Primary Bedroom – King bed, private en suite bathroom Guest Bedroom – King bed, shared hallway bathroom Bunk Room – Twin-over-twin bunk, shared bathroom Bonus Space – Daybed with trundle AREA ATTRACTIONS: Located in laid-back Seagrove Beach, 30A Sun Joy offers easy access to 30A’s best. Spend your days biking to Seaside for shopping and dining, exploring rare dune lakes at Deer Lake State Park, or relaxing on the quiet beach just steps from your door. With local favorites like Café Thirty-A, Surfing Deer, and Seagrove Village Market nearby, you’ll enjoy a perfect blend of Old Florida charm and modern luxury.Show less
